confidence_notes: FX is from an RBA search result showing 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 November 2026. Food and drink anchors rest on one search of crowdsourced mylifeelsewhere.com data for Varanasi, which was inconsistent across its pages. Beer, cappuccino and inexpensive meal are loosely supported by that data. The mid-range meal is scaled from the inexpensive meal. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer price and general knowledge, not searched. Varanasi is a largely alcohol-restrained pilgrimage city with few bars, so alcohol prices are especially uncertain, and wine is rare and expensive relative to local prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Varanasi's own crowdsourced data, with cross-checks against typical prices in other mid-sized North Indian tourist cities such as Agra and Jaipur.
